rationale: The mixed_death_keeps_prefix_tag_open failure exposed a real gap: boundary() only retained row-start tags for a mixed membership death. Now any invalid boundary flushes the pre-row snapshot as valid-prefix unknowns, so the possible_starvation_err@3 survives in _tag_mixed with no death and no refutation; test and fixture unchanged.
Double counting avoided by clearing the snapshot in close_epoch and exhaust (which already flush tags); row-e tags are never in the snapshot since it is taken before processing.
K11 accounting added as an association-free sub-obligation with explicit delimitation of unmeasured subchecks.
Stale P1/P4 and status list superseded in contract.md; properties.json VERDICT synced.
contract_decisions: Proposed (not normative): valid-prefix tags at any first invalid boundary are open unknowns with original tag rows.
Proposed (not normative): K11 activation unit = non-reset processed row; schema and rule 3.20 checks unmeasured.
Undefined i_sdata pin-FIFO-head rule remains a scoped assumption pending independent review; no formal obligation claimed proven.
